subject: MATHEMATICS
title: Division Fact Families
objective: Connect multiplication with sharing and grouping division.
introduction: Division can share a total among known groups or find the number of groups of a known size. Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: Adding the same number again and again.
A symbol or word that tells how many.
